zh.title: 澳洲男子認罪襲擊洛杉磯機場（LAX）安檢人員下月判刑
zh.summary: 澳洲男子賓漢認罪於洛杉磯機場襲擊安檢人員；因行李事件抓扯官員最高面臨八年監禁
body: 一名名為湯瑪斯·賓漢（Thomas Bingham）的澳洲籍男子，已就於美國洛杉磯國際機場襲擊運輸安全管理局（TSA）人員一事向法院承認有罪。該起事件起源於機場航廈內的一起行李遺失糾紛，賓漢在過程中動手抓扯了一名執行勤務的TSA安檢人員。
在完成認罪程序之後，賓漢預定於下個月正式接受司法判決。根據涉案法條與相關指控，這名澳洲籍男子因在洛杉磯國際機場襲擊安檢官員，未來最高可能面臨長達八年的有期徒刑判決。

en.title: Australian Man Pleads Guilty to Assaulting TSA Officer at LAX (LAX)
en.summary: Thomas Bingham pleaded guilty to assaulting a TSA officer at LAX; sentencing is scheduled for next month.
body: Australian national Thomas Bingham has pleaded guilty in court to assaulting a Transportation Security Administration (TSA) officer at Los Angeles International Airport . The guilty plea stems from an incident inside the airport terminal during which Bingham grabbed a TSA security officer in connection with a dispute over a lost bag.

Following his admission of guilt, Bingham is scheduled to be formally sentenced next month. For the offense of assaulting an officer at the airport, he faces a maximum potential penalty of up to eight years in prison under federal sentencing guidelines.
